sources.title: hx03-info/SmolGRPO-135M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Details Model Description SmolGRPO-135M is a small reasoning-oriented language model fine-tuned using GRPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm for improving reasoning and explanation quality. The base model, SmolLM-135M-Instruct, was further optimized using a reward function focused on completion quality and length.
